Scan R scripts for CBS column usage

Source: R/scan_columns.R
sim_scan_columns.Rd

Parses R scripts and extracts column names from read_sav() calls that use col_select. Returns a named list suitable for passing to sim_export()'s col_select parameter.

Usage

sim_scan_columns(paths)

Arguments

paths

Character vector of file or directory paths. Directories are searched recursively for .R files.

Value

A named list of character vectors, keyed by uppercase CBS file name (e.g. list(SPOLISBUS = c("RINPERSOON", "IKVID", ...)).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cols <- sim_scan_columns("my_project/scripts/")
sim_export("output", dataset = "spolis", col_select = cols)
} # }
